annotation.justification: The clause explicitly states that a 200 response always has content, but that content may be zero length. The term 'content' is defined in the preceding context as the representation of the response. Thus the clause unambiguously requires a body (which may be empty) and does not allow a 200 response without any body. No alternative materially different implementation behaviours are permitted by the wording.
